interpretation: Devito4.8.23 uses a fixed nine-digit symbolic FD-coefficient precision even with f64 data. An explicit in-memory override to17 digits aligns coefficient precision with Earth Forge. No installed package or Earth Forge solver was changed, and predeclared thresholds were retained. Both default and matched-precision evidence are saved. This comparison verifies the stated synthetic PDE/stencil, not geological fidelity, absorbing boundaries, or SOTA performance.
boundaryScope: The comparison includes matching zero-halo boundary conditions; late fields may contain reflections. Absorbing-boundary accuracy is checked separately against a larger domain.
